svg.text: Early walk-down decomposition: altitude reference vs velocity state vs predictor drag penalty
Pre-settling coast altitude bias: mean 6.0 ft, max 9.8 ft
Pre-settling coast velocity bias: mean 14.9 fps, max 31.5 fps
Coast start uplift if fixed: altitude 5.5 ft, velocity 248.4 ft
First settling uplift if fixed: altitude 5.5 ft, velocity 191.7 ft
Coast start -> settling: logged -128.7 ft, ballistic -210.8 ft, drag penalty change 82.2 ft
Pad reference uses the flight code convention: first nonzero barometer sample. Baro velocity is a centered 0.30 s regression slope.
